newsitem.title: PERU: Peru net reserves rise to $9.991 bln as of Aug 13.
newsitem.headline: Peru net reserves rise to $9.991 bln as of Aug 13.

text.p: Peru's net international reserves rose to $9.991 billion in the week ended August 13 from $9.904 billion the week before, the Central Reserve Bank said Friday.
Reserves, which have climbed steadily during President Alberto Fujimori's seven years in office, stood at $8.540 billion at the end of 1996.
The bank said its foreign exchange position, or total liquidity minus short and long-term debt obligations, was $2.135 billion on August 13.
